description: This file implements a circular buffer (queue) with both static and dynamic memory management options, including functions for initialization, push, pop, and destruction, primarily used in embedded systems or AUTOSAR-based projects.

methods.name: CirqBuff_Init
methods.description: Initializes a static circular buffer with provided memory buffer, maximum count, and data size.

methods.name: CirqBuffStatCreate
methods.description: Creates and initializes a static circular buffer object with given buffer, size, and data size.

methods.name: CirqBuffDynCreate
methods.description: Dynamically allocates and initializes a circular buffer with specified size and data size.

methods.name: CirqBuffDynDestroy
methods.description: Frees memory allocated for a dynamic circular buffer.

methods.name: CirqBuffPush
methods.description: Pushes data into the circular buffer; returns 0 on success, 1 if full.

methods.name: CirqBuffPop
methods.description: Pops data from the circular buffer; returns 0 on success, 1 if empty.

methods.name: CirqBuff_PushLock
methods.description: Provides a pointer to the buffer location for direct data insertion; returns NULL if full.

methods.name: CirqBuff_PopLock
methods.description: Provides a pointer to the buffer location for direct data retrieval; returns NULL if empty.
